localBiteReport: The inshore bite around Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay is in excellent shape this week, with local guide Capt. Adam Schroeder calling it one of the best of the year. Bait is now easy to find early in the morning, and that abundance is driving solid action on redfish, flounder, and trout, with both slot-sized and bull reds biting well around bridges and structure on an outgoing tide. Live croakers and spot minnows are the go-to for bigger redfish near the Destin and Brooks bridges, while flounder are mixing in on the same structure-focused live-bait presentations. Water temperature is 86°F. Flounder season closes October 15, so now is a good window to target them before the fall closure.
